The conversation will kick-off from the very brief suggested reading providing easy access to all attendees both to the philosopher and the conversation. Let´s be greek and dive today on… **a Philosophical question called forgiveness...** **It’s unusual to think of forgiveness as a topic of philosophical relevance. How does a seemingly personal decision between people becomes a philosophical universal question ?** **Building from the work of Margaret Holmgren and Trudy Govier, American and Canadian contemporary philosophers, we will examine the philosophical dimensions of forgiveness.** **What does it truly mean to forgive? Are there actions that go beyond the realm of the forgivable?** **Are there people who are beyond that realm? Who gets to decide?** **Should we forgive ? Always ? In any case ?** **And how our systems, such as the criminal justice system, grapple with these inquiries every single day?** **Margaret Holmgren (1951 ) is an American professor specializing in ethics and the philosophy of law.
